2609.11674.title: Geospatial AI, Dataverse Metadata, and the Study of Place-Based Government
2609.11674.paper_summary: Harvard Dataverse hosts over 150,000 research datasets, but the geographic information those datasets carry is entered as free text by depositors and has never been assembled into a searchable structure. We construct a knowledge graph from the repository's public data and metadata, organizing 102,650 datasets within a 215,985-node network of 528,003 edges linking datasets to keywords, publications, subjects, journals, and locations. Of those datasets, 43,991 (42.9 percent) carry at least one geospatial field, geographic coverage, geographic unit, or a bounding box and 96.9 percent of all nodes sit in a single connected component, so datasets remain reachable from one another even when their geospatial metadata share nothing in common. A conservative keyword search identifies 7,654 geospatially tagged datasets (17.4 percent) as directly policy-relevant, with elections and legislatures the largest cluster, followed by government administration, health policy, transportation, and education. Five datasets illustrate how this metadata behaves across policy domains and spatial scales, and an extended use case shows how community language models, stance detection with geographic aggregation, and partisan language bridging tools can attach discourse to place. The central obstacle is place resolution: the same location appears as many disconnected nodes. We argue that the graph provides a concrete setting for developing AI-driven metadata enrichment and entity resolution, and we document its coverage skew toward American, city-level data.
2609.11674.paper_summary_zh: 哈佛數據庫擁有超過150,000個研究數據集，但這些數據集所攜帶的地理信息是由存儲者以自由文本形式輸入的，從未組成可搜索的結構。我們從該庫的公共數據和元數據中構建了一個知識圖譜，將102,650個數據集組織在一個包含215,985個節點和528,003條邊的網絡中，這些邊將數據集與關鍵字、出版物、主題、期刊和地點相連。在這些數據集中，有43,991個（42.9%）至少包含一個地理空間字段、地理覆蓋範圍、地理單位或邊界框，並且96.9%的所有節點位於單一連通組件中，因此即使它們的地理空間元數據沒有共同之處，數據集之間仍然可以互相訪問。一個保守的關鍵字搜索識別出7,654個地理空間標記的數據集（17.4%）與政策直接相關，其中選舉和立法機構是最大的集群，其次是政府管理、健康政策、交通和教育。五個數據集展示了這些元數據在政策領域和空間尺度上的表現，擴展的使用案例顯示社區語言模型、地理聚合的立場檢測和黨派語言橋接工具如何將話語與地點連接起來。主要障礙是地點解析：同一位置出現為許多不相連的節點。我們認為該圖譜為開發基於AI的元數據增強和實體解析提供了具體的背景，並且我們記錄了其對美國城市級數據的覆蓋偏斜。
2609.11674.author: Danny EBanks et.al.
